name: Dr Harneesh Randhawa
quote: I installed a SUNROOOF variant in my kitchen, and I love the product and the vibe it creates. The service deserves equal praise. When one panel stopped working properly, the team replaced it promptly at no extra cost. I highly recommend SUNROOOF to anyone planning a new home or a renovation. Cheers 🥂

name: Ms. Nitai Dasa
quote: The product looks great and works well. The design and installation teams were very efficient and cooperative.

name: Mr. Shiv Gupta
quote: I installed SUNROOOF at my home and the experience was excellent. The work quality was very good and the installation was done professionally. It has brought beautiful, natural-feeling light into my home and enhanced its overall look. Highly recommended!

name: Mr. Abhishek Malani
quote: Got SUNROOOF installed in my new house, and it’s stunning. It turns a dark space into a bright, well-lit one, just like daylight. The mode change feature is amazing too. The team did a great job with the installation and explained everything clearly afterwards. Excellent product, excellent company. Kudos!

name: Mr. Ramkumar Allu
quote: Very unique and reliable product. This sunroof is the centre of attraction in our mall

name: Sandeep Reddy
quote: Excellent product. Deepak Sharma handled everything, from delivery to installation and commissioning. Once the team arrived, they finished and handed it over in one working day, all done professionally.

name: Chandini Hemdev
quote: We found SUNROOOF on Instagram, and the way the product was shown and explained made us want it for our new home right away. The process took a couple of months, since the team was then based only in Delhi and had to travel for measurements, but they were very prompt. The initial fixing came with precise instructions. We loved working with Ishat, Nadeem and the whole SUNROOOF team. The finished product is now our favourite corner of the house. 😍

name: Nezz
quote: SUNROOOF is the most stunning addition you can make to transform a space and bring in natural-feeling light. I recently built a sound healing studio in my basement, so it got no daylight at all. Once I discovered SUNROOOF, I knew I had to install it, and I’m glad I did. It has transformed the space, it looks truly premium, and everyone who visits loves it. Highly recommend!

name: Vaibhav Goel
quote: Amazing thing, we got it installed in our kitchen and changed the whole dimensions. A bit expensive but totally worth it.

name: Amandeep Singh
quote: Excellent service. A fused light was identified and repaired within just two days. The team was professional, efficient and kept me informed throughout. Quick turnaround and quality work. Very satisfied.

name: Dharmi Sindhwani
quote: Excellent product. I’m really happy with the installation, especially Nadeem’s work. My kitchen now looks like it’s filled with sunlight. Thanks to the SUNROOOF team!

name: Punit Thakkar
quote: Incredible technology. It doesn’t look like a light fixture. It looks like a real skylight with genuine depth. Unlike regular LEDs, it changes colour through the day, giving you morning energy or a sunset mood automatically. It truly feels like natural sunlight.

name: Kundan Save
quote: I specified SUNROOOF for a high-end residence where I did the interiors. The quality was amazing and it gave a near-perfect daylight effect. The light temperature shifts on schedule were accurate and lifelike. Thanks to the SUNROOOF team!

name: Manvi Bansal
quote: SUNROOOF is the best addition to my home. It feels like real daylight pouring in, and it fills a dark room with so much positivity. I’m glad I chose SUNROOOF.

name: Neetu Mann
quote: A great product, unlike anything I’ve seen. At our new site, no one could tell there was a regular ceiling above it. It feels just like the sky. We’ll definitely use it on more sites.
